_comment: Covered calls' browser tools. AutolaunchWeb.ToolManifest adds them to tool_manifest.json only while the site offers covered calls (AUTOLAUNCH_COVERED_CALLS=true). A public tool's `request` is the HTTP request it makes: `path` with each {field} filled from its input, and `body` the input fields it posts.

tools.name: autolaunch_covered_call_listings
tools.title: List covered calls on a stock
tools.description: List the covered calls on one Base stock token, as its contract holds them at the latest block: every listing with its seller, strike_per_token and premium_per_token (micro-USDC per whole token), expiry (a Friday at 21:00 UTC, Unix seconds), amount, filled and available (raw token units, unit per whole token) and stage (open, sold, exercise or closed), the stock's multiplier and its reference price. Reads only; needs no sign-in. The reading is shared and may be up to five minutes old; read_at says when it was taken.

symbol.description: The stock token's symbol exactly as the site lists it, such as AMZNc.

tools.name: autolaunch_covered_call_quote
tools.title: Suggest a covered-call premium
tools.description: Suggest a premium per whole token for a covered call on one Base stock token at a strike and weekly expiry, from the stock's reference price. A guide for a seller only: the contract enforces nothing from it, and it is refused while the reference price is more than four days old. Reads only; needs no sign-in.

symbol.description: The stock token's symbol exactly as the site lists it, such as AMZNc.

strike_per_token.description: The strike in micro-USDC (6 decimals) per whole token.

expiry.description: A Friday at 21:00 UTC, as Unix seconds; listings take no other expiry.

tools.name: autolaunch_my_covered_calls
tools.title: Read my covered calls on a stock
tools.description: Read my person's covered calls on one Base stock token, for their signed-in wallet, at the latest block: the listings it sold and, on every listing, the calls it may exercise (held) and the stock it may claim (claimable), in raw token units. Changes nothing. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.

symbol.description: The stock token's symbol exactly as the site lists it, such as AMZNc.

tools.name: autolaunch_covered_call_prepare
tools.title: Prepare a covered-call step
tools.description: Prepare the wallet steps for one covered-call action on a Base stock token: list (amount, strike_per_token, premium_per_token, expiry), fill (listing_id, amount), exercise (listing_id, amount), cancel, claim or collect_strike (listing_id). The steps are for one of my person's own wallets: signer when given, otherwise the wallet they signed in with; any other wallet is refused. The site only prepares: the wallet's own key signs and sends each step in turn (to, data, value on chain), and money moves only then. approved says whether the allowance already covers the action; blocked names, in code and words, a reason the chain's current state makes the action certain to fail, and the steps are still returned. Changes nothing. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.

symbol.description: The stock token's symbol exactly as the site lists it, such as AMZNc.

listing_id.description: The listing's number on this market, for every kind but list.

amount.description: Raw stock token units: to list, to buy (fill) or to exercise.

strike_per_token.description: For list: the strike in micro-USDC per whole token.

premium_per_token.description: For list: the minimum premium in micro-USDC per whole token.

expiry.description: For list: a Friday at 21:00 UTC, as Unix seconds.

signer.description: One of my person's own wallet addresses, 0x and 40 hex digits. Omit it to use the wallet they signed in with.
